flags.message: Provisioned lower-court-docket.txt reports that no rehearing dissent was noted, but petition.txt at printed pages 12–13 describes five judges dissenting in two opinions and cites appendix pages 94 and 96–131. I relied on the petition's specific account, while recognizing that the appendix and decision below were not provisioned and a CourtListener citation search returned no match. This is an input-summary discrepancy, not outcome leakage or a blocker.
